text.tspan: WHO RUNS WHAT IN PATTERN B (SOVEREIGN SILO) — ZERO SHARED INFRASTRUCTURE
per-tenant GCP project, VPC-SC, PAB, 2 gateways & HSM CMEK
Dedicated stack per tenant; customer holds Cloud HSM / EKM key (<60s HTTP 403 halt on revoke).
dedicated front end, ADK runtime (Confidential GKE), MCP, A2A & PT models
Zero shared compute pods or model endpoints; capacity scales per tenant silo via PT or GKE.
dedicated Valkey sessions + dedicated AlloyDB, BigQuery & HNSW vector index
Physical DB & HNSW index per tenant encrypted with tenant CMEK (zero shared tables or RLS).
